title: DWG LAYOUT viewport-list closure and DXF entity-space projection
scope: Correct the strict adapter's assumption that the DWG LAYOUT viewport handle array must enumerate every emitted paper-space VIEWPORT, while retaining closure for each listed handle.

authority.contract: DWG LAYOUT list handles and the last-active handle are source relationships. DXF has no counted LAYOUT viewport-list field: preserve the complete paper-space entity set through unique BLOCK_RECORD/LAYOUT ownership, and serialize the last-active viewport separately as group 331.
authority.limits: The reviewed Autodesk DXF tables do not define a DWG-list-to-DXF sequence mapping. The ObjectARX getViewportArray API describes a complete layout array; the local AC1024 source has paper-space entities despite an empty array, so this receipt qualifies only the bounded adapter preservation policy and generated output behavior. Native layout activation/rendering remains open.

sourceObservation.before: Strict conversion read 395/395 source frames with zero entity/object parse failures, then refused because emitted paper-space VIEWPORT 0x490 was absent from its DWG LAYOUT viewport list.
sourceObservation.after: Strict conversion passes viewport projection and refuses later at the unqualified dynamic-block object profile. The file still does not produce a strict DXF.
sourceObservation.independentPeer: The retained LibreDWG 0.14 JSON/DXF observations in the prior research receipt show Layout1 with an empty viewport array and active_viewport 0x490, while its BLOCK_RECORD-owned paper-space entities include VIEWPORT 0x490 and 0x492. This is a source observation, not native application acceptance.
sourceObservation.oda: A local ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0 retry aborted before conversion with macOS pasteboard/XPC errors (exit 134); no output or compatibility result was obtained.

behavior: Every declared DWG LAYOUT viewport handle remains subject to the existing typed paper-space target, uniqueness, owner/layout, and emitted-identity checks.
Every retained paper-space VIEWPORT with a uniquely resolved layout owner participates in per-layout DXF 68/69 projection even when it is absent from the DWG counted array.
The LAYOUT last-active handle remains a separate validated and remapped group-331 reference; the source viewport-list order is not used as a DXF stacking-order claim.

cases: A paper-space layout with two retained VIEWPORT entities and an empty DWG viewport list exports and reads back.
A one-handle list with an unlisted last-active VIEWPORT preserves all six generated VIEWPORT entities and remaps group 331 to the correct owner and projected identity.
Count mismatch, missing target, wrong target kind, cross-layout target, duplicate list entry, and a declared target with no retained VIEWPORT still refuse atomically.

physicalSource.result: Expected strict refusal at dynamic-block objects after viewport preflight advanced; no qualified output was published.

qualification.closed: Generated ASCII/Binary adapter projection preserves complete owner-backed paper-space VIEWPORT entities independently from the DWG counted array and validates all declared list edges plus group-331 remapping.
open: Native viewport activation, rendering, and ordering semantics.
The physical Sun-and-Sky source remains blocked by dynamic-block output qualification and other graph gates.
